|---|---|---|
| 1 destroyed issue cancelled by a new card | `withDestroyedIssues`: an unledgered issue whose own read answers 404/410 keeps the run red; verdict `destroyed` when the counts agree | 2 cases red |
| 2 cut-short reconcile vs first board | a cut-short reconcile reports the FIRST census against the FIRST board read; the reconcile runs under `BOARD_READ_RESERVE` (5) so the second read fits | repaired census vs first board: 1 case red |
| 3 cut-short drops the record | the outcome (re-read / transferred / destroyed) is kept and the summary says CUT SHORT | 3 cases red |
| 4 gone subtracted twice | only gone numbers the census counted open are subtracted | 1 case red |
| 5 fake fetch ignores redirect | the stub follows redirects unless `manual`, the destination serves its own card; a 200 naming another number or repo is `unreadable` | dropping `redirect: 'manual'`: 4 cases red |
| 6 5xx unreachable | reply mode returns 5xx as the number's verdict | the self-test throws (red) |
| 7 (optional, done) | every verdict is reconciled, an agreeing one too | 3 cases red |

Live, against a fresh copy of `board-archive`: run 1 first census SURPLUS 3 → reconciled → `ok`, exit 0. Run 2: first census agreed; 5 destroyed **pull requests** named, issue verdict `ok`, exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.

Note on acceptance: `Fixes #27726` closes the card on merge, **before** the acceptance run. The seat reads the first scheduled `Fleet Patrols` snapshot after merge.
